feature: Transfer Order yard milestone posting without Driver completion

scenarios.behavior: Ordinary yard-to-yard IF is admitted from a valid saved loading record without receiving or Driver completion; no source read if that loading record is missing.
A saved full or partial receipt admits IR after matching IF is verified, without Driver completion. IR waits for IF if queued, failed, uncertain or absent.
IF failure cannot block receiving list, detail, confirmation or receipt submission. Local receipt quantities remain saved and cannot be received twice.

Retries and concurrent workers preserve immutable quantities, command ID and external ID. Previously waiting jobs advance under the new rule; completed and attention jobs retain their recovery contracts.
Posting rechecks durable local records and fulfillment evidence. Wrong order/scope/quantity, over-receipt and missing records cannot authorize IR.
Ordinary TO load history does not say waiting for driver completion. Sales/CO/VRMA and linked direct-to-customer SO evidence remain protected.
Existing yard authorization, photos, closed order protections, NetSuite source validation, sync preservation and direct-to-customer behavior remain intact.

failureModel: Early or duplicate IF/IR: real database admission, worker retries and concurrency tests
Lost receipt after remote failure: HTTP and repository local receiving regression
Over-receipt or unrelated evidence: quantity properties and adversarial scope cases
Direct-to-customer regression: existing linked SO suites
Misleading UI history: history evidence integration

setup.tooling: Existing Node, fast-check, c8, TypeScript, ESLint; standard disposable Compose under mbbs-tests.slice with teardown trap before startup

additionalCriteria: Consolidated TO loading must also remain local and use the background queue, without synchronous NetSuite source lookup.
Ordinary transfer posting commands record a null Driver completion identity; linked SO commands retain their completion identity and checks.
